text:
Root cause: option declarations were stored in the parser using their original casing, while command-line tokens were normalized before lookup. This made declarations like `--Name` unreachable when normalization lowercased input.

Changed option registration to normalize declared option names as well, including short and long forms. Existing normalization and option tests pass: **529 passed**.

final_text:
Root cause: option declarations were stored in the parser using their original casing, while command-line tokens were normalized before lookup. This made declarations like `--Name` unreachable when normalization lowercased input.

Changed option registration to normalize declared option names as well, including short and long forms. Existing normalization and option tests pass: **529 passed**.
